density.label: 1,000 distinct apps on one host
density.source: sproutd benchmarks/a22-density-2026-11-05 (private repo): Porffor alpha 22, 5 trials on host instabox-romeo (Linux 6.18, x86_64)
density.limits: cgroup MemoryMax=1536M, MemorySwapMax=0, one CPU for the host, the load client on another
density.note: One trial reached the memory cap and the kernel killed a process; every one of its 5,000 requests was still answered correctly. The other four passed.

coldStart.note: Cold start is measured live in section 1 and at build time for the standalone binary (section 4). No older figure is shown.
